patch_samples.sample_text: Added God Bot Achilles

SMITE 2 flattened god Base Stats to improve flexibility. That worked, but it reduced some of the core differences between gods. We’re reintroducing some of that texture. Each god now has one standout base stat that fits their kit, like Kukulkan’s mana or Achilles’ physical protections. That makes gods feel more distinct without sacrificing flexibility.
* Achilles has received a major Ability VFX rework and his targeters have been visually updated
Achilles Nerf
Achilles Nerf
Achilles added.

aspects.name: Aspect of Prowess
aspects.description: Combat Dodge can now be recast after striking a Jungle Monster or Boss, with Spear Strike gaining increased Scaling when forgoing Achilles's Armor. Radiant Glory no longer grants increased Protections or Crowd Control Reduction.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: Hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack provides 1 stack of Combustion. Hitting an enemy god provides 2. At 4 stacks Agni's next Flame Wave or Rain Fire will ignite all enemies hit, dealing Magical Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds. When Agni kills an enemy god, he goes on a Hot Streak. When on a Hot Streak, Combustion is fully charged and using Flame Wave or Rain Fire does not consume Combustion

patch_samples.sample_text: Agni (Nerf)
Agni Aspect (Shift)

“Agni’s Aspect currently scales with the rank of the triggering ability, leading to his early game pressure to be quite high. A level 6 Agni with 3 ranks of Flame Wave will currently deal 108 Base, and potentially up to 180 Base at max stacks before we consider scaling. We are adjusting it to no longer consider the rank of the ability triggering and only consider Agni’s Level. The same situation w
Agni’s Basic Attacks now have a projectile sound.

* Agni
** Aspect of Combustion
*** Removed: Critical strikes no longer provide 2 stacks of Ignite

* Agni (Nerf)
** Aspect of Combustion
*** Rain Fire (4)
**** Decreased Damage from 135/175/215/255/295 to 120/150/180/210/240
** Rain Fire (4)
*** Increased Cooldown from 18s to 20s

* Agni
** New Aspect releasing April 28 - Aspect of Combustion
*** Your Basic Attacks now ignite enemies dealing damage over time and stacking 5 times. Flame Wave and Rain of Fire consume ignites dealing a burst of damage. Rain of Fire deals reduced damage.
Agni Buff

patch_samples.sample_text: Shields applied to everyone other than Apollo are increased by 3% of Apollo’s Max Health
Music volume has been increased at the request of Apollo.
Can no longer gain stacks of Audacity while an empowered So Beautiful is available.
No longer applies the Attack Speed Buff to Apollo.

* Apollo Aspect
** So Beautiful (1)
*** NEW: Increased Enhanced So Beautiful Mana Cost from 0 to 20/25/30/35/40
*** Decreased Damage Scaling Contribution from 15% to 10% Item Health
** Serenade (2)
*** Decreased Base Shield from 60/100/140/180/220 to 50/85/120/155/190

* Apollo
** General
*** Ranged Basic Attacks
*** Damage Type: Physical
*** Scaling Type: Strength Scaling
** Passive: Audacity
*** Gain a stack of Audacity for each successful Basic Attack on an enemy and for each successful damaging ability on Enemy gods. At 10 stacks you gain 100% Attack Speed and Increased Basic Attack Projectile Speed for his next 5 Basic Attacks.
** Ability 1: So Beautiful
**

aspects.name: Aspect of Harmony
aspects.description: Audacity now grants free So Beautiful casts but no Attack Speed. So Beautiful scales with item Health, lowers enemy Attack Speed, and grants nearby allies Attack Speed on god or jungle boss hits, but deals less Base Damage. Serenade now shields nearby allies and grants Protections while it holds. Buffing an ally grants an Audacity stack.

patch_samples.sample_text: Added Ares and Kali bots
Ares (Nerf)
Ares (Nerf)

* Ares Buff
** Searing Flesh (3)
*** Increased Damage Per Tick from 15/20/25/30/35 to 20/25/30/35/40
** No Escape (4)
*** Increased Initial Damage from 60/80/110/120/140 to 80/110/140/170/200
Ares gains 10/15/20/25/30 HPS while the buff is active on himself. This does not apply to his Aspect Call to Arms.
Ares Buff

* Ares No Escape now cripples enemies that he chains, meaning you are now unable to buffer movement abilities into his Ultimate. This ability will still cripple even when our CC Buffering tests are not active.
Ares Buff
Decreased the amount of STR and INT Ares grants to nearby allies to 50% of the effect he gains (6.25% prots and 50% cdr)
Decreased bonus Strength from Protections from Items from 20% to 12.5%
Initial Damage shifted from 65/90/115/140/165 + 25% Strength to 60/80/100/120/140 + 30% Strength

patch_samples.sample_text: “Baron Samedi, Yemoja, and the recent addition of Aspect Eset have been very strong at higher levels of play, pushing out other gods with their high ranged pressure and base damage. We are adjusting all three in different ways tailored to their unique cases. However, wanted to be reserved as Lifebinder, a key rush item, is also receiving adjustments in this patch to reduce that early pressure.”

Ex. Baron Samedi’s Consign Spirits does require hitting an enemy god, but can apply to a full team. Its ‘base’ amount of healing was more reduced, while its conditional component of healing hurt targets was hit a bit less.

* Baron Samedi
** Aspect of Hysteria - Releasing June 9
*** Hysteria applied over max deals damage. Max Hysteria no longer reduces damage. Consign Spirits only heals Baron. Vivid Gaze bonus now grants Hysteria over time, but no debuff.  Wrap It Up explosion and DoT apply Bonus Hysteria, but the explosion no longer Mesmerizes. Your personal Brew can be thrown every 20s.
Baron Samedi Buff

* Baron Samedi Buff
** Wrap It Up (3)
*** Decreased Cooldown from 16s to 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s
** Life of the Party (4)
*** Increased Slam Damage and Intelligence Scaling from 125/210/295/380/475 + 55% to 200/270/340/410/480 + 70%

“Baron Samedi had a bug in CA8 that reduced all enemies’ damage to every target, leading to a massive overperformance across the board. After fixing this, we gave him time to settle since he had been oppressive since his original release in Smite 2. Now, we’ve seen him struggle to perform, so we’re reverting a few of the changes we made before discovering the bug.”
Baron Samedi Buff
--- Baron Samedi's root volume increased. Baron Samedi "Ta-Da!" on A01 volume reduced

* Baron Samedi Nerf
** Consign Spirits
*** Decreased Heal from 30/60/90/120/150 to 30/55/80/105/130
*** Decreased Missing Health Heal from 2.5% to 2%
Baron Samedi Nerf

patch_samples.sample_text: Cat Dash Base Damage reduced from 40/65/90/115/140 to 25/50/75/100/125
This means that Bastet can no longer extend (or shorten) the hitbox with movement of her camera.
All Gods level 1 basic attack damage is reduced by 20%, across the board. This brings base basic attack damage more in-line with SMITE 1. It still scales as it did before.
Base Health has been adjusted to have a bigger gap between Gods associated with different traditional roles. Additionally some Gods had some Protections adjusted:

aspects.name: Aspect of the Watchful Pride
aspects.description: Pounce can no longer be activated again to return to you to your starting location; hitting an enemy god with it grants Protections to nearby allies. Razor Whip deals less damage but Disarms bleeding enemies. Ensnaring Claw Stuns instead of Rooting. Cat Call becomes Huntress of Bast.

Jungle.why: Bellona · Jungle · archetype «aa_assassin» (STR / physical). ASPECT «Aspect of Vindication». Bludgeon no longer deals bonus Final Slam Damage but whenever Bellona gains Block Stacks with Sword and Shield or gains Health from Scourge, Kit effects: basic-attack kit, self heal / drain, shields, hard crowd control, dash / leap engage, CC immunity in kit. Tags: aa, anti_cc, burst, gap_close, hard_cc, heal, heavy_shield, high_cc. Style burst 63%/dps 37%; patch stable (net +0.3, r5 +0.0). Patch axes (r5): damage +0.5, general -0.2, heal +0.0. Scale STR 70% / INT 0%. Path: Jotunn's Revenge (CDR + pen for gank/engage); Odysseus' Bow (Jungle path fit for kit profile); Hydra's Lament (CDR + pen for gank/engage). Pen: Jotunn's Revenge, Titan's Bane, The Crusher. Actives 1/3 · pen ≈ 35. Soft high-SR inspiration on 4 item(s) (tracker.gg — not a meta copy).

patch_samples.sample_text: Max Health Heal per Target Scaling Reduced from .75% to .5%
Tick Damage reduced from 9/13/17/21/25 + 15% Strength and 20% Intelligence to 5/9/13/17/21 + 15% Strength and Intelligence
Fixed Cabrakan Aspect nerfs missing from last week's hotfix

* Cabrakan Nerf
** Refraction Shield (2)
*** Decreased Damage from 70/120/170/220/270 to 50/105/160/215/270
**** This affects both normal and Enhanced Refraction Shield
Now provides Cabrakan an additional 1% Damage Mitigation for every 100 Protections from Items.

aspects.name: Aspect of the Rotund Jotunn
aspects.description: Seismic Crush Stealths you and Slows enemies instead of Stunning. Refraction Shield stacks energy by dealing damage and bonus damage instead of a Stun. Jungle.why: Cabrakan · Jungle · archetype «mage_jungle» (INT / magical). ASPECT «Aspect of the Rotund Jotunn». Seismic Crush Stealths you and Slows enemies instead of Stunning. Refraction Shield stacks energy by dealing damage and bonus damage instead Kit effects: channel / cast time, big ult spike, basic-attack kit, attack-speed steroid, hard crowd control, ally buffs / auras. Tags: aa, as_steroid, burst, channel, hard_cc, heal, high_cc, long_cd. Style burst 43%/dps 67%; patch falling (net -4.0, r5 -2.8). Patch axes (r5): damage -1.3, general -1.0, heal -0.3. Scale STR 75% / INT 51%. Path: Book of Thoth (mana stack → power scaling); Spear of Desolation (flat pen + CDR for ability burst); The Cosmic Horror (penetration required for damage role). Pen: Book of Thoth, Spear of Desolation, The Cosmic Horror, Obsidian Shard, Rod of Tahuti. Actives 0/2 · pen ≈ 45. Soft high-SR inspiration on 2 item(s) (tracker.gg — not a meta copy).

gods.name: Cerberus
gods.title: Warden of the Underworld
gods.rationale: Patch trajectory: volatile; Last touch: neutral in SMITE 2 Open Beta 36; Kit 11/100 (burst/dps/utility blend), build fit 41/100; Ranked WR 52.5% (ladder 63/100, smitebrain+tracker, n=219); Suggested cores: Shifter's Shield, Gluttonous Grimoire
gods.build_notes: Primary role Solo · archetype «sustain_solo». Same path engine as Conquest Builds (actives ≤2). Magical damage → INT / magical cores. Patch axes (r5): survivability -0.9, general -0.5. Cerberus · Solo · archetype «sustain_solo» (INT / magical). Kit effects: self heal / drain, pet / deployable, hard crowd control, dash / leap engage, burst combos, lots of CC. Tags: dot, gap_close, hard_cc, heal, high_cc, long_cd, pet_zone, self_sustain. Style burst 100%/dps 0%;

Minion bonus damage increased from 55% to 60%

* Cupid Nerf
** Aspect of Love

** Share the Love (2)
*** Decreased Base Damage from 80/130/180/230/280 to 65/115/165/215/265
Cupid Nerf

* Cupid Nerf
** Share the Love
*** Decreased Heal from 20/40/60/80/100 + 10% INT to 20/35/50/65/80 + 7.5% INT
** Fields of Love
*** Decreased Heal from 60/100/140/180/220 + 30% INT to 60/95/130/165/200 + 20% INT
New Feature: If Cupid has 8 stacks of Lovestruck, the explosion Stuns instead of Mesmerizes.
Dash forward quickly, gaining an Attack Speed buff and leaving behind a trail that lasts for 6s.

Support.aspect_description: Contest of Gods only provides you extra Attack Damage from Intelligence. Unruly Magic does not explode but returns back, dealing damage and providing a stack causing your next attacks to explode. Erratic Behavior no longer creates a field of stealth but attack speed and attack damage. Golden Apple of Discord is faster and does not spread.

starter.name: Selflessness
starter.effect:
Ally god within 8.8m is hit by Hard CC:
*Shield them for 25+5% of your Max Health
*Cooldown: 20s
Requires Level 20 to upgrade
starter.why: Support starter — aura gold & early bulk

patch_samples.sample_text: Hun Batz (Nerf)
Hun Batz (Nerf)
* Arcane Ape Hun Batz (Out-of-Game): Adjusted weapon offset to prevent clipping with hat.

* Hun Batz Buff
** Aspect of Disruption
*** Overhand Smash (2)
**** Increased Damage from 50/80/110/140/170 to 60/100/140/180/220
** Infused Strikes (P)
*** Increased Strength per stack from 2 to 5
** Somersault (1)
*** Increased Damage from 65/105/145/185/225 to 75/115/155/195/235
**** This also affects the second hit from this ability

“Hun Batz relies on his ultimate for the bulk of his power, making it tough to give his other abilities meaningful impact. We’re reducing the maximum Crowd Control it provides, adding some bonus scaling, and with this change we can increase the potency of Overhead Smash. Overhead Smash will no longer go on cooldown if interrupted, which requires us to move the Protection Shred off the channel and
Infused Strikes Slow gods hit by them, but do not grant Hun Batz the stacking Strength buff.

Increased the speed of the dash by 33%
Ishtar Rolling Thunder can now fired in walls properly

aspects.name: Aspect of the Passionate Storm
aspects.description: Your Spread Shot cone is always active on your Attacks. Imbue Arrows no longer changes stance; it grants Attack Speed and lets you build Storm's Kiss whenever you hit a target with an Attack while Imbue is active. Rolling Thunder now grans you small Movement Speed bonus per strike. Jolt consumes Storm's Kiss stacks on hit; at 8 or more stacks, the arrow you fire after the backflip deals bonus damage, and at 15 or more stacks the Rooted target explodes for bonus Physical Damage over double the area when you land.

Carry.aspect_description: Your Spread Shot cone is always active on your Attacks. Imbue Arrows no longer changes stance; it grants Attack Speed and lets you build Storm's Kiss whenever you hit a target with an Attack while Imbue is active. Rolling Thunder now grans you small Movement Speed bonus per strike. Jolt consumes Storm's Kiss stacks on hit; at 8 or more stacks, the arrow you fire after the backflip deals bonus damage, and at 15 or more stacks the Rooted target explodes for bonus Physical Damage over double the area when you land.

patch_samples.sample_text: No longer grants a charge of Explosive Bolts
Jing Wei Buff

“Jing Wei took a big hit after we removed the knockup and damage from Persistent Gust for enemies who walked into it after its initial deployment. We’re restoring these effects at a reduced strength, ensuring foes still need to respect the gust when chasing or retreating. At the same time, this adjustment prevents her from regaining the free wave clear that originally prompted the change.”
Jing Wei Nerf

Kali (Buff)

* Kali (Nerf)

*** Decreased Base Damage Intelligence Scaling from 40% to 30%.
*** Decreased Bonus Damage Strength Scaling from 12.5% to 10%.
*** Decreased Bonus Damage Intelligence Scaling from 17.5% to 12.5%.
*
Kali (Nerf)

* Kali
** Incense (3)
*** Decreased Bonus Intelligence Scaling per Rupture Stack from 22.5% to 17.5%.
*** Decreased Base Damage from 40/65/90/115/140 to 35/55/75/95/115.

* Kali

*** Decreased Bleed Intelligence Scaling from 15% to 10%.

Support.why: Neith · Support · archetype «lockdown_support» (STR / physical). ASPECT «Aspect of Wind». Broken Weave explosions no longer Root enemies and the Buff has a reduced duration however the Attack Speed gained is much higher. Additiona Kit effects: channel / cast time, big ult spike, basic-attack kit, attack-speed steroid, hard crowd control, dash / leap engage. Tags: aa, as_steroid, burst, channel, gap_close, hard_cc, heal, high_cc. Style burst 56%/dps 54%; patch stable (net +0.0, r5 +0.0). Patch axes (r5): general +0.1, utility -0.0, attack_speed -0.0. Scale STR 63% / INT 77%. Path: Gauntlet of Thebes (team aura / support core); Chandra's Grace (team aura / support core); Jotunn's Revenge (CDR + pen for gank/engage). Pen: Jotunn's Revenge, Transcendence. Actives 0/2 · pen ≈ 5. Soft high-SR inspiration on 1 item(s) (tracker.gg — not a meta copy).

* Nemesis Buff
** Swift Vengeance (1)
*** Increased Damage of each Dash from 50/80/110/140/170 to 60/90/120/150/180
** Slice and Dice (2)
*** Increased Center Damage Strength Scaling from 80% to 90%
Nemesis Buff

patch_samples.sample_text: Bonus Magic Damage per stack reduced from 5% -> 2.5%
Nut (Base Buff, Aspect Nerf)

Nut’s Convergence is now properly considered a single ability fire, regardless of the amount of ammo that you have. This means that subsequent shots will properly know if the previous shots had triggered an item effect and will respect once per ability or once per ability target rules.

aspects.name: Aspect of the Cosmos
aspects.description: Flux becomes Cosmic Flux (Mitigation, decays). Decaying past 10 stacks Heals allies. Base Damage +10%, Scaling -25%. Convergence grants a mini version of itself to allies on god hit. Crashing Comet Stuns and Slows. Warp grants CC immunity to self and 1 nearby ally. -12.5% Basic Attack Damage.

patch_samples.sample_text: Ra (Buff)

* Ra Buff
** Searing Pain (4)
*** Increased True Damage dealt from 5% to 8% of Target’s Max HP
Increased Magical Protection from 30 to 40

* Ra Shift
** Celestial Beam
*** Increased Damage Scaling from 100% INT to 105% INT
** Divine Light
*** Shifted Solar Ray Damage from 30/70/100/130/160 + 45% INT to 25/60/85/110/135 + 55% INT
*** Increased Cooldown from 12s to 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s
** Solar Blessing
*** Increased Damage Scaling per tick from 25% INT to 30% INT
Shifted Solar Ray Damage from 30/70/100/130/160 + 45% INT to 25/60/85/110/135 + 55% INT

Fixed an issue where the Towers near the Teleporters could be hit from outside their range with longer penetrating basic attacks (Ra’s Divine Light). Now if you hit the Tower from over the wall, you’ll be considered as a valid target for 1 second and get hit unless you leave the radius, so free Tower damage can no longer happen
Ra Buff
This buff stacks up to 3 times
The Divine Light blind has been adjusted to be a bit less harsh for photosensitive people.

patch_samples.sample_text: Now has Intelligence and Strength scaling
No longer has Knockback but has Intelligence and Strength scaling
Sobek (Buff)

* Sobek Nerf
** Tail Whip (2)
*** Increased Cooldown from 12s to 13s
** Sickening Strike (3)
*** Increased Cooldown from 12s to 13s

* Sobek Shift
** Aspect of Prey
*** Charge Prey (1)
**** Increased Base Damage from 70/110/150/190/230 to 85/125/165/205/245
**** Increased Damage Scaling from 75% to 85%
** Sickening Strike (3)
*** Decreased God DoT Damage from 5/5.5/6/6.5/7% HP over 2.5s to 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% 
** Lurking in the Waters (4)
*** Decreased Base Damage from 300/450/600/750/900 to 300/420/540/660/780
Sobek Shift
Updated VFX rendering for the Lil Bites Sobek Lurking in the Waters (Ability 4) and lowered opacity for non-local players.
Sobek Buff
Sobek Nerf

* Sobek Nerf
** Charge Prey
*** Increased Cooldown from 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s to 16s at all ranks
Sobek Nerf
Sob-execute! Sobek can now execute enemies at low health, scaling the HP Threshold with the length of his change.
Sobek’s Charge Prey no longer continues for the full time if an enemy dies or becomes CC Immune during the pluck sequence; instead ending early.
Fixed various issues with Sobek's Buff and Debuff tooltips missing text

starter.effect:
Ally god within 8.8m is hit by Hard CC:
*Shield them for 25+5% of your Max Health
*Cooldown: 20s

items.effect:

God Kill or Assist: +5 Stacks.

*+100 Max Health

items.effect:

patch_samples.sample_text:
* Susano Buff
** Wind Siphon (2)
*** Increased Damage from 90/120/150/180/210 to 90/130/170/210/250
** Typhoon (4)
*** Increased Max Damage from 220/285/350/415/480 to 250/310/370/430/490

“Susano has continued to struggle despite our recent buff attempts, so we’re implementing more significant changes to help him thrive. His original Smite 1 Passive was a powerhouse, but the newer version proved too difficult to fully utilize. By cutting the stacks in half, Susano can now build and maintain his passive more easily, although it still requires three inhand cancels for its full effect
Susano’s pull should now better attempt to keep targets in their relative position in the cone when they are pulled to Susano.

* Susano Buff
** Storm’s Edge
*** Increased Buff/Debuff Duration from 3s to 4s
** Typhoon
*** Increased Knockup Height by 25%
Susano Nerf
Susano Nerf
Removed the Typhoon VFX that was visible while this ability was building up.
Adjusted the projectile VFX to not cover up the hit VFX as much, and updated the hit VFX to be more visible.
Increased the maximum radius from 3.2m to 4m.

patch_samples.sample_text: “Yemoja on the other hand is pretty firmly only using her non-aspect in Support, focusing our adjustments to her Support playstyle to be just nerfs. Her early game pressure is high, but we want her to return to her current strength by as early as mid game. Separately, her Aspect is getting some additional scaling to offset these adjustments and help bring up a struggling Aspect.”
Yemoja Buff

* Yemoja Buff
** Mending Waters (2)
*** Increased Shield Health and Scaling from 30/55/80/105/130 + 2% Max Health to 40/65/90/115/140 + 4% Max Health
** River’s Rebuke (4)
*** Decreased Cooldown from 140/135/130/125/120s to 120s

* Yemoja Buff
** Aspect of Downpour
*** Moonstrike (1B)
**** Increased Inner hit Damage Scaling from 75% to 85%
*** Mending Waters (2)
**** Increased Subsequent bounce damage from 50% to 65%
Yemoja’s Ability 2 targeter sizing has been adjusted to match gameplay
Yemoja Buff
Mending Waters no longer affects allies but stops and bounces on enemy gods, dealing damage, shield damage and providing Yemoja 6/7/8/9/10 Int per hit, stacking up to 6 times, for 10s.

* Yemoja Nerf
** Mending Waters
*** Decreased Shield Health from 30/60/90/120/150 + 3% Max Health to 30/55/80/105/130 + 2% Max Health
Yemoja Buff
Yemoja Nerf

starter.name: Selflessness
starter.effect:
Ally god within 8.8m is hit by Hard CC:
*Shield them for 25+5% of your Max Health
*Cooldown: 20s
Requires Level 20 to upgrade
starter.why: Support starter — aura gold & early bulk

Assist a Minion: +1 Stack.
God Kill or Assist: +5 Stacks.
Stacks grant +15 Max Health (max 40 Stacks).

*+100 Max Health
*+10 Physical and Magi

builds.method: Multi-phase Conquest algorithm (docs/BUILD_ALGORITHM.md): hard gates → role job → buy-order spikes → kit archetype slots → ladder/patch → soft high-SR inspiration → light flex diversify. God kit (effects/tags/scaling) + items:overall ladder + optional data/tracker_inspiration.json (nudge only). Hard bans: damage type, god-only items, healer cores, removed shop. Shop actives ≤2 (hard max 3). Damage roles ≥20 matching pen. Order is first-class: Mid Book/Deso + % pen before luxury Echo; Carry Tyrfing → Exec/OBow → Titan before crit; Jungle Jotunn → Crusher/pen → Titan before toys. Damage roles must hurt tanks early (pen/shred in first 3–4 items). Carry: native Carry only on base kit; off-role flex only via aspects that convert basics to ranged (e.g. Geb Calamity, Kali Unbound).

recommended_gods.why: Kali · Carry · archetype «crit_adc» (STR / physical). ASPECT «Aspect of Unbound Destruction». Kali's Basics are ranged. Rupture procs at 5 stacks to deal damage & heal her. Incense doesn't stun or proc Rupture but knocks back & applie Kit effects: protection shred, basic-attack kit, attack-speed steroid, self heal / drain, heavy healing, execute / threshold. recommended_gods.why: Geb · Support · archetype «shield_support» (INT / magical). Kit effects: hard crowd control, dash / leap engage, ally buffs / auras, CC immunity in kit, lots of CC, shields. Tags: anti_cc, dot, gap_close, hard_cc, high_cc, long_cd, shield, team_buff. Style burst 65%/dps 35%; patch volatile (net -1.2, r5 +0.0). Patch axes (r5): damage -0.6, survivability -0.5, crit -0.2. Scale STR 0% / INT 36%. Path: Gauntlet of Thebes (team aura / support core); Shifter's Shield (offline hybrid tank); Chandra's Grace (team aura / support core). Actives 0/2 · pen ≈ 0. Soft high-SR inspiration on 5 item(s) (tracker.gg — not a meta copy).

flex_item_guide.title: Flex & weird items — simple English
flex_item_guide.disclaimer: Plain-language guides for situational and concept items. Not live win rates. When in doubt: answer the lobby (heal/crit/AS/magic/CC) before toys.

items.name: Alchemist Coat
items.simple: Using consumables gives dampening; free Multi Potion over time if you have a slot.
items.how: Potion engine + tankiness when you chug.
items.when: You buy pots and want free value.
items.when_not: Never use consumables.

items.name: Amanita Charm
items.simple: Active drops a healing mushroom zone that heals and stacks damage reduction.
items.how: Place for team heal + DR in a pit or under tower.
items.when: Teamfight support who holds ground.
items.when_not: You never group or use actives.

items.name: Bancroft's Talon
items.simple: The lower your HP, the more INT and lifesteal you get.
items.how: Comeback / low-HP fighter mage. Risky: rewards being hurt.
items.when: Aggressive LS mages who fight in the red.
items.when_not: You play full HP safe poke only (still usable, less ideal).

items.name: Bloodforge
items.simple: STR + lifesteal; active gives a big health shield that also buffs LS.
items.how: All-in vamp. Press shield when you dive.
items.when: Physical divers who auto/spell vamp.
items.when_not: Pure tank with no damage; mage INT path.

items.name: Brawler's Beat Stick
items.simple: Hitting gods applies 25% healing reduction + you stack combat stats.
items.how: Anti-heal for bruisers/hybrids. Adaptive STR or INT from your build.
items.when: Enemy heals/lifesteals and you’re a damage or hybrid role.
items.when_not: No heals; pure tank with no damage to apply it.
items.buy_as: Solo/Jungle/Carry into sustain; sometimes Mid hybrid.

items.name: Circe's Hexstone
items.simple: Active: poly dash with CC immune and prots; hitting a god knocks up and deals % current HP.
items.how: Engage/peel dash toy. Build so you can afford the active slot.
items.when: You want a displacement engage on a tank.
items.when_not: Active slots already full of better tools.

items.name: Contagion
items.simple: Enemies who hit you or lifesteal off you get stacks. You AA or hard CC them to explode stacks for % of YOUR max HP damage.
items.how: Not real anti-heal. Soft punish freefire/LS. You must detonate with AA or hard CC.
items.when: You’re the freefire tank into LS ADC/bruisers.
items.when_not: You need 25% heal cut (buy Stygian/Brawler’s/Divine instead); you’re mid glass.
items.buy_as: Tank flex; never your only anti-heal into Aphro.

items.name: Daybreak Gavel
items.simple: Healing different gods builds stacks; your next non-heal ability spends stacks for a big STR/INT buff.
items.how: Heal unique allies → cast damage/utility spell to cash power.
items.when: Team healers who also cast non-heal abilities.
items.when_not: You only damage and never heal.

items.name: Divine Ruin
items.simple: Mage anti-heal: your god damage cuts healing 25% + lightning proc.
items.how: The mid-lane answer to Aphro/Yogi’s/sustain. Also INT power.
items.when: Any real healing on the enemy (or you’re not sure — safe default mid).
items.when_not: Full glass lobby with zero sustain and you need pure burst sooner.

items.name: Doublet of Binding
items.simple: Active links an ally: you take 20% of their damage (mitigated by your dampening).
items.how: Bodyguard button. Stack damp/prots so the redirected damage is soft.
items.when: You peel one carry hard (Athena/Geb/Ymir).
items.when_not: You’re the one dying first with no bulk.

items.name: Eros' Bow
items.simple: Mark an ally; your basic attacks heal that ally for a % of your max HP.
items.how: You’re an AA battery for the carry. Mark them and auto anything.
items.when: You basic-attack a lot and peel with the ADC.
items.when_not: Ability-only support who never autos.

items.name: Erosion
items.simple: Enemy shields near you are much weaker; you gain prots when that happens.
items.how: Anti-shield aura. Great into shield-heavy kits/items.
items.when: Lots of shields (Berserk shields, item shields, kit shields).
items.when_not: Nobody shields — wasted slot.

items.name: Ethereal Staff
items.simple: Ability hits steal max HP (and mana) from the target over time stacks.
items.how: You get thicker, they get thinner across the fight. Needs multiple ability hits.
items.when: Long fights vs HP stackers.
items.when_not: You cast once and die; no multi-hit kit.

items.name: Eye of Erebus
items.simple: Active drops an eye that blasts % max HP, reveals, and slows the first enemy in range.
items.how: Trap/zone tool + adaptive power. Place on chokes or objectives.
items.when: Roam/setup tanks and bruisers.
items.when_not: You never use actives or set vision traps.

items.name: Eye of Providence
items.simple: Dual prot + free sentry wards over time; gold for killing wards.
items.how: Vision item. Keeps wards in your inventory loop.
items.when: Enemy wards everything / you want free sentry uptime.
items.when_not: You already have perfect vision and need combat stats more.

items.name: Gauntlet of Thebes
items.simple: Stacks max HP from assists; fully stacked gives more HP and dual prots for the team aura fantasy.
items.how: Support farm item. Stack on minions/gods → evolve power.
items.when: Almost every Support game as core.
items.when_not: You’re not actually supporting (full damage mid).

items.name: Genji's Guard
items.simple: Big magical protection; getting hit by magic shortens your cooldowns.
items.how: Mage damage answer. They hit you with magic → you get CDs back.
items.when: Fed mid mage or magical damage everywhere.
items.when_not: All physical lobby (ADC + phys jungle only).

items.name: Gluttonous Grimoire
items.simple: Part of your lifesteal is stored as bonus damage on your next basic attack.
items.how: Cast/LS → bank → AA to dump a chunk. Stores more at full HP.
items.when: INT + lifesteal mages (Hades, Anubis-style).
items.when_not: No LS; you never basic attack.

items.name: Heartwood Charm
items.simple: Healing abilities cool down faster; heals you cast store a bank; active dumps that heal to nearby allies.
items.how: Spam heals to fill the bank → press active for a team heal bomb.
items.when: Healer supports (Yemoja, Aphro, etc.).
items.when_not: No heal abilities.

items.name: Magi's Cloak
items.simple: Every so often, the next hard CC on you is blocked (short CC immunity).
items.how: Anti-lockdown bubble on a cooldown. Saves you from root/stun openers.
items.when: Heavy hard CC / dive (Bastet, Fenrir, Ymir lock, etc.).
items.when_not: Soft poke only, no real CC threat.
items.buy_as: Anyone getting locked before they can act.

items.name: Mantle Of Discord
items.simple: When you drop low, you stun nearby enemies and get CC immune briefly.
items.how: Panic button passive at low HP. Long cooldown.
items.when: You’re the dive target and need a last-stand peel.
items.when_not: You never drop low / never frontline.

items.name: Mantle of Discord
items.simple: When you drop low, you stun nearby enemies and get CC immune briefly.
items.how: Panic button passive at low HP. Long cooldown.
items.when: You’re the dive target and need a last-stand peel.
items.when_not: You never drop low / never frontline.

items.name: Midgardian Mail
items.simple: When they basic-attack you, their attack speed drops (stacks).
items.how: They freefire you → they get slower. You want them hitting you (frontline).
items.when: ADC or AA jungler is freefiring your face.
items.when_not: Nobody basics you (pure mage poke from range).
items.buy_as: Support/Solo tank path when AA is the problem.

items.name: Obsidian Shard
items.simple: % magical penetration + first ability cast gets bonus pen (Shattering).
items.how: Makes mage damage actually land on tanks. First cast of the cycle is juicier.
items.when: Any mid that needs to kill tanks / bulk.
items.when_not: Never finishing pen into triple tank (you’ll bounce).

items.name: Omen Drum
items.simple: Active: abilities mark enemies for 5s, then a % of the damage you dealt is echoed to all marked.
items.how: Multi-hit ability combos shine. Press before full rotation.
items.when: Ability spam kits in teamfights.
items.when_not: One-spell pokes; you forget actives.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.simple: Magic bulk + active pulses that heal you and true-damage nearby enemies.
items.how: Tank mprot item with a panic heal/true damage button.
items.when: Magic damage + you want a self-peel active.
items.when_not: You need pure aura peel and never press actives.

items.name: Prophetic Cloak
items.simple: Damaging gods stacks protections vs their damage type; evolves into stronger dual prot + mitigation.
items.how: Adaptive tank: fight people → stack the right prots → evolve.
items.when: Frontliners in long games who hit a lot of gods.
items.when_not: You need an immediate answer (Spectral/Genji’s) this fight.
items.buy_as: Early tank scaler; evolve is the payoff.

items.name: Sanguine Lash
items.simple: Nearby enemies take % HP damage over time; scales with your lifesteal. Active makes ticks faster.
items.how: Melee sit-on-them item. Build LS and stay in range.
items.when: Melee LS assassins/bruisers.
items.when_not: Ranged poke; no LS.

items.name: Shifter's Shield
items.simple: High HP: free STR or INT. Low HP: free dual protections.
items.how: Hybrid tank/damage. Healthy = offline damage; hurt = tank mode.
items.when: Solo/Support default bulk almost always.
items.when_not: Full glass ADC/mid who never wants prots.

items.name: Soul Reaver
items.simple: Ability hits deal extra damage based on the target’s health (base + item HP).
items.how: Tank shred for mages. Still goes through prots — buy pen too.
items.when: Fat tanks, Thebes stacks, Yogi’s bricks.
items.when_not: All glass enemies and you need pure burst/CDR sooner.

items.name: Spectral Armor
items.simple: You and nearby allies take less damage from critical hits.
items.how: Passive aura. Stand near your carry — they get part of the anti-crit too.
items.when: Enemy has a crit Carry (or anyone building crit). Default Support flex almost every game.
items.when_not: No crit threat at all (full ability damage lobby).

items.name: Spirit Robe
items.simple: When hard CC’d, you gain a big dual-prot buff and a small heal.
items.how: CC makes you tankier briefly. Note: enemies can ‘proc’ this on purpose.
items.when: Lots of hard CC and you’re frontline.
items.when_not: You want to avoid giving them free value; Magi’s is cleaner for ‘don’t get CC’d’.

items.name: Staff of Myrddin
items.simple: Active: your next non-ult ability has no cooldown.
items.how: Double-cast button. Huge on burst mages with a key spell.
items.when: Your combo is one ability twice (or reset a big CD).
items.when_not: Low impact abilities; you need pen/heal cut first.

items.name: Stampede
items.simple: Active: you and nearby allies get slow immunity and a huge decaying speed boost.
items.how: Engage or disengage button for the whole team.
items.when: You need team move for fights/rotates (classic support).
items.when_not: Rarely — it’s a standard support tool when speed wins fights.

items.name: Stone of Binding
items.simple: Your hard CC shreds their physical and magical protections (stacks).
items.how: Only works if you land hard CC (stun/root/knockup/etc.).
items.when: You have reliable hard CC (Ymir, Atlas, Hades, etc.).
items.when_not: Soft CC only / no CC in kit.
items.buy_as: CC gods — synergy item, not random bulk.

items.name: Stygian Anchor
items.simple: Your damage cuts enemy healing 25% and slows their attack speed in stacks.
items.how: Real anti-heal on ability damage (not Contagion). Also shreds AS.
items.when: Aphro, Yogi’s, Cu sustain, heavy lifesteal, heal comps.
items.when_not: Zero healing on the enemy team.
items.buy_as: Support/Solo whenever heals are real — don’t wait until item 6.

items.name: Titan's Bane
items.simple: % physical penetration + first ability cast bonus pen (Shattering).
items.how: Same idea as Obsidian for physical. Don’t skip into bulk.
items.when: Physical damage roles mid/late.
items.when_not: You only AA and never cast (still usually good).

items.name: Toxic Blade
items.simple: Your basics apply healing reduction and attack-speed slow.
items.how: AA-based anti-heal. You must basic-attack them.
items.when: You’re Carry/AA jungle into heals.
items.when_not: Ability-only mage; you never auto.
items.buy_as: Carry flex vs heal / high AS.

items.name: Umbral Link
items.simple: Above 50% HP, your lifesteal healing is shared with nearby allies (and gives them small prots).
items.how: You’re a mobile vamp aura. Must build lifesteal and stay healthy next to teammates.
items.when: Physical LS bruisers (Fenrir, Kali, Chaac paths) who group fight.
items.when_not: No LS; always under 50% HP; you never stand near allies.
items.buy_as: After or with Bloodforge/DG-style LS cores.

items.name: Vital Amplifier
items.simple: When you heal yourself or an ally with an ability, they get attack speed and attack damage (stacks 3×).
items.how: Heals = AA steroids for your team. Needs a healing kit and allies who basic-attack.
items.when: You’re Yemoja/Aphro/Ra/Baron-style healer with an ADC who autos.
items.when_not: No heals in kit; team is all ability mages who never AA.

items.name: Void Shield
items.simple: Nearby enemies have less physical protection (stronger up close).
items.how: Aura shred for physical carries/junglers.
items.when: You’re peeling in front of a physical ADC/jungle.
items.when_not: Full magical team.

items.name: Void Stone
items.simple: Nearby enemies have less magical protection (stronger up close).
items.how: Aura shred for magical damage dealers on your team (or you).
items.when: You’re frontline with mage allies, or magical bruiser.
items.when_not: All physical team and you’re not magical.

items.name: Xibalban Effigy
items.simple: For 4s you only take half damage, then you pay back what you blocked (as physical). Can’t kill yourself below 5% HP.
items.how: Press when a big burst is landing. You delay death, not become immortal. Moonlight = half the payback.
items.when: You’re a frontline tank and enemy has big ult combos.
items.when_not: Glass builds; long AA freefire with no spike; pressing it with nobody hitting you.
items.buy_as: 2nd–3rd item on Ymir/Atlas/Xing-style tanks after some bulk.

items.name: Yogi's Necklace
items.simple: Fat HP/mana + constant heal for 0.5% of your max HP every second.
items.how: Regen brick. On Cu, mana also becomes more HP via his passive. Wins long fights, not burst.
items.when: You want to outlast lane and never die to chip.
items.when_not: You need damage spike or real anti-heal answer on you.
